statement.p: If the gradient of f is \nabla f = x\,\mathit{\vec j}-3z\,\mathit{\vec i}+2yx\,\mathit{\vec k} and the point P = (10, 6, 3) lies on the level surface f(x, y, z)=0, find an equation for the tangent plane to the surface at the point P.

static.solution: P=(10,6,3) we have \mbox{grad}\, f = -9\,\mathit{\vec i}+10\,\mathit{\vec j}+120\,\mathit{\vec k}. Hence the tangent plane to the level surface f(x, y, z)=0 at the point P is given by the equation 10\mathopen{}\left(y-6\right)-9\mathopen{}\left(x-10\right)+120\mathopen{}\left(z-3\right) = 0, or z = 3-\frac{10\mathopen{}\left(y-6\right)-9\mathopen{}\left(x-10\right)}{120}.
